ns2:section.sectionText: PERSONAL FINANCIAL PLANNING - Reserved for Juniors & Seniors only. A survey of the financial planning process and industry, this course covers investment, tax, insurance, and retirement planning. Applicable to those interested in creating a sound personal financial plan early in one's working career and those interested in becoming a financial planner. A special emphasis is put on real-world solution: Asset allocation, spreadsheets, Monte Carlo simulations, etc. (This is the same course as LAS 199, section JM, CRN 41167.)
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
